description: All text must meet WCAG AA minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text
do_example: Use #1a1a1a text on #ffffff background (ratio 17.4:1)
dont_example: Use #999999 text on #ffffff background (ratio 2.8:1)

description: Information conveyed by color must also be available through text or icons
do_example: Error messages use red color AND an error icon AND descriptive text
dont_example: A form field turns red with no other indication of the error

description: Every meaningful image must have descriptive alt text and decorative images need empty alt
do_example: alt="Product dashboard showing weekly analytics chart"
dont_example: No alt attribute or alt="image1.png"

description: Every input must have a visible associated label not just placeholder text
do_example: <label for="email">Email address</label><input id="email">
dont_example: <input placeholder="Email address"> with no label element

description: All interactive elements must be reachable and operable via keyboard alone
do_example: Tab order follows visual layout and all buttons and links are focusable
dont_example: Custom dropdown only works with mouse click events

description: Focused elements need a clearly visible focus indicator that is not just color
do_example: outline: 2px solid #2563eb with 2px offset on focused elements
dont_example: outline: none on all elements for aesthetic reasons

description: Long pages need a skip-to-main-content link for keyboard and screen reader users
do_example: Hidden link appears on focus: Skip to main content
dont_example: No skip link forcing keyboard users to tab through entire nav

description: Check user motion preferences and disable or reduce animations accordingly
do_example: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { * { animation: none; } }
dont_example: Complex parallax animations with no reduced-motion alternative

description: Interactive elements must be at least 44x44px for touch and 24x24px minimum for mouse
do_example: Button padding: 12px 24px creating a 44px minimum touch target
dont_example: Small 16x16px icon buttons with no padding

description: Use proper heading hierarchy h1-h6 and semantic landmarks
do_example: Single h1 then h2 for sections then h3 for subsections in order
dont_example: Multiple h1 tags or skipping from h1 to h4

description: All clickable elements must show pointer cursor to signal interactivity
do_example: cursor: pointer on buttons links and interactive cards
dont_example: Default cursor on a clickable card that navigates somewhere

rule: Hover states for all interactive elements
description: Every clickable element needs a visible hover state change
do_example: Button changes background color and slight translateY(-1px) on hover
dont_example: Button has no visual change when hovered

description: Pressed/active state should provide immediate visual feedback
do_example: Button scales to 0.98 or darkens on :active
dont_example: No :active style making clicks feel unresponsive

description: Touch targets need minimum 8px gap between them to prevent misclicks
do_example: Button group with gap: 8px minimum between each button
dont_example: Navigation links with 2px gaps causing frequent misclicks on mobile

description: If swipe actions exist provide visual hints like partial next-item visibility
do_example: Carousel shows 10% of next card peeking from the edge
dont_example: Full-width carousel cards with no indication more content exists

description: Critical actions must not require hover since touch devices have no hover
do_example: Dropdown opens on click/tap not just on hover
dont_example: Navigation submenu only appears on mouseenter event

description: Images below the fold should lazy load and all images need proper sizing
dont_example: Full-size 4000px images loaded eagerly for thumbnail displays

description: Use font-display swap and preload critical fonts to prevent layout shift
do_example: <link rel="preload" href="font.woff2" as="font"> with font-display: swap
dont_example: Three Google Font families loaded without preload causing FOIT

description: Reserve space for dynamic content images and ads to prevent CLS
do_example: Image containers have explicit width/height or aspect-ratio set
dont_example: Images load and push content down causing visible page jumps

description: Large applications should split code by route to reduce initial bundle
do_example: Dynamic import() for route components loading only what is needed
dont_example: Single 2MB JavaScript bundle for entire application

description: Above-the-fold CSS should be inlined to prevent render blocking
do_example: Critical hero styles inlined in head with rest loaded async
dont_example: All 200KB of CSS loaded as render-blocking stylesheet

description: Use a spacing scale (4px or 8px base) consistently throughout the design
do_example: Spacing uses 8/16/24/32/48/64px consistently matching design tokens
dont_example: Random spacing like 13px 27px 41px with no system

description: Body content should have a max-width (usually 1200-1440px) with centered layout
do_example: max-width: 1200px with margin: 0 auto for main content
dont_example: Full-width text spanning 2560px on ultrawide monitors

description: Design must adapt to mobile (320px) tablet (768px) and desktop (1024px+)
do_example: Fluid layout with grid that stacks on mobile and expands on desktop
dont_example: Fixed 1200px width layout that requires horizontal scroll on mobile

description: Navigation should remain accessible especially on long pages
do_example: Sticky header with position: sticky; top: 0 and subtle shadow on scroll
dont_example: Navigation scrolls away on a long page forcing scroll-to-top to navigate

description: Fixed/floating elements like CTAs must not obscure content on small screens
do_example: Floating CTA hides on scroll-down appears on scroll-up with close option
dont_example: Fixed bottom CTA covering 20% of mobile viewport permanently

description: Use a systematic z-index scale to prevent stacking context conflicts
do_example: Z-index scale: base 0 dropdown 100 sticky 200 modal 300 toast 400
dont_example: Random z-index values like 9999 and 99999 fighting each other

description: Cards in a grid must have consistent height and aligned content
do_example: CSS grid with equal height cards and content aligned with flexbox
dont_example: Cards of different heights creating ragged grid layout

description: Sidebars should have consistent width and collapse properly on mobile
do_example: 240px sidebar collapses to hamburger menu below 768px breakpoint
dont_example: Fixed sidebar that overlaps content on tablet-size screens

description: Build from smallest screen up adding complexity at larger breakpoints
do_example: Base styles for mobile then @media (min-width: 768px) adds columns
dont_example: Desktop layout crammed into mobile with overflow and tiny text

description: Increase padding and target sizes on touch devices
do_example: Buttons get extra padding on mobile: padding: 16px 32px at small breakpoints
dont_example: Same 8px padding buttons on mobile and desktop

description: Font sizes should scale with viewport using clamp() or fluid values
do_example: font-size: clamp(1rem and 2vw and 1.5rem) for fluid scaling
dont_example: Fixed 48px heading that dominates mobile screens

description: Designs must not break at 320px which is the smallest common viewport
do_example: Content wraps gracefully and remains readable at 320px
dont_example: Text or buttons overflow viewport at 320px causing horizontal scroll

description: Serve appropriately sized images for each viewport with srcset
dont_example: Single 2400px hero image served to all devices

description: Body text should have line-height between 1.5 and 1.8 for comfortable reading
do_example: p { line-height: 1.6; } for body text
dont_example: p { line-height: 1.1; } making lines feel cramped

description: Text blocks should not exceed 65-75 characters per line for readability
do_example: max-width: 65ch on paragraph elements
dont_example: Full-width paragraphs spanning 120+ characters per line

description: Body text should be at least 16px (1rem) for comfortable reading
do_example: font-size: 16px (1rem) for body with larger for less sharp displays
dont_example: font-size: 12px body text requiring users to zoom

description: Each heading level should be visually distinct from adjacent levels
do_example: h1: 48px bold / h2: 36px semibold / h3: 24px medium with clear steps
dont_example: h1: 24px and h2: 22px with barely noticeable difference

description: Specify system font fallbacks that match metrics to prevent layout shift
do_example: font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif
dont_example: font-family: 'CustomFont' with no fallback causing invisible text

description: Elements should animate in once on viewport entry not continuously
do_example: Cards fade in with translateY on first intersection observer trigger
dont_example: Cards constantly bouncing in an infinite animation loop

description: UI transitions should be 150-300ms and page transitions 300-500ms
do_example: transition: all 0.2s ease for hover states
dont_example: transition: all 2s ease making the interface feel sluggish

description: Avoid animating large sections on initial page load which delays usability
do_example: Hero content is visible immediately with subtle fade on secondary elements
dont_example: Entire page animates in over 3 seconds before user can interact

description: Use ease-out for entrances ease-in for exits and ease-in-out for state changes
do_example: transform with transition-timing-function: ease-out for elements entering view
dont_example: Linear timing on all animations creating robotic mechanical movement

description: Show skeleton screens or spinners during content loading
do_example: Skeleton loader with pulsing animation matching content layout shape
dont_example: Blank white screen while content loads with no loading indication

description: Scroll animations should enhance not distract from content consumption
do_example: Subtle 20px translateY with opacity fade on section entry
dont_example: Aggressive 200px slide with rotation and scale on every element

description: Never use emoji characters as UI icons - use proper SVG icon libraries
do_example: Lucide or Heroicons SVG icon for checkmark or arrow or menu
dont_example: Using emoji characters for navigation menu buttons or status indicators

description: All icons should come from one library or have matching stroke weight and size
do_example: All icons from Lucide React with consistent 24px size and 1.5px stroke
dont_example: Mixed Font Awesome filled icons with Heroicons outline icons

description: Show company or product logos as proper SVG images not styled text
do_example: <svg> logo mark with proper viewBox scaling
dont_example: Company name in a styled <span> pretending to be a logo

description: Use a single border-radius scale throughout the design system
do_example: Radius scale: sm 4px / md 8px / lg 12px / xl 16px / full 9999px
dont_example: Random radius values: 3px here then 7px there then 11px elsewhere

description: Use consistent elevation shadows from a defined scale
do_example: shadow-sm/md/lg/xl tokens used consistently for elevation
dont_example: Random box-shadow values with different colors and spreads everywhere

description: Define colors as semantic tokens not raw values throughout the codebase
do_example: Using var(--color-primary) and var(--color-text) semantic tokens
dont_example: Hardcoded #3b82f6 scattered across 47 different files

description: Dark backgrounds need lighter borders and adjusted shadow opacity
do_example: Dark cards: bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 with subtle rgba shadow
dont_example: Dark cards with no border making elements blend into background

description: Images may need reduced brightness or adjusted background in dark mode
do_example: Images get subtle brightness(0.9) filter in dark mode
dont_example: Bright white product images blinding users in dark mode

description: Saturated colors from light mode need desaturation for dark backgrounds
do_example: Primary blue shifts from #2563eb to #60a5fa for dark mode
dont_example: Same bright #2563eb on dark background creating harsh vibrating contrast

description: Use dark gray (#0a0a0b to #18181b) not pure black (#000) for main backgrounds
do_example: background: #0f0f10 for dark mode base
dont_example: background: #000000 causing maximum contrast strain on eyes

description: Show validation state as user completes fields not only on submit
do_example: Email field shows green checkmark after valid email is typed
dont_example: All errors only appear after clicking submit

description: Error messages should say what went wrong and how to fix it
do_example: Password must be at least 8 characters with one number
dont_example: Invalid input

description: Place labels above input fields not to the side for consistent mobile layout
do_example: Label stacked above input with 4px gap between them
dont_example: Side-by-side label and input that breaks on mobile

description: Disabled elements must be visually distinct with reduced opacity and tooltip explaining why
do_example: opacity: 0.5 with cursor: not-allowed and title explaining requirement
dont_example: Disabled button that looks the same as enabled but does nothing on click

description: Long forms should show progress and allow navigation between completed steps
do_example: Step indicator: Step 1 of 4 with clickable completed step dots
dont_example: 20-field form on single page with no progress indication

description: Navigation must clearly show the current active page or section
do_example: Active nav link with bold weight and bottom border indicator
dont_example: All nav links look identical with no active state

description: Pages more than 2 levels deep should have breadcrumb navigation
do_example: Home > Products > Category > Product Name as clickable breadcrumb
dont_example: Product detail page with no way to navigate back to category

description: Navigation should collapse to accessible hamburger menu on mobile
do_example: Hamburger icon that opens full-screen nav overlay on mobile
dont_example: Desktop navigation wrapping to 3 lines on mobile screens

description: Navigation with 20+ items needs organized mega menu not a long dropdown
do_example: Categorized mega menu with sections and featured items
dont_example: Single dropdown list with 35 unsorted navigation links

description: Show skeleton placeholder matching content layout during data fetching
do_example: Gray pulsing rectangles matching card layout while data loads
dont_example: Blank page with only a small spinner in the center

description: UI should update immediately on user action before server confirmation
do_example: Like button fills immediately then reverts only if server request fails
dont_example: Like button shows spinner for 2 seconds waiting for server response

description: Operations taking more than 3 seconds need a progress indicator
do_example: File upload shows progress bar with percentage and estimated time
dont_example: File upload shows only spinning wheel with no progress indication

description: Empty views should guide users on what to do next with illustration and CTA
do_example: Empty inbox illustration with text: No messages yet and a Compose button
dont_example: Blank white page with only the text: No data

description: Error pages should explain what happened and offer a path forward
do_example: Error page with description and Retry button plus link to home page
dont_example: Generic 500 page with only: Something went wrong

description: First-time users should see guided empty states not bare interfaces
do_example: New dashboard shows Welcome card with 3 setup steps and sample data option
dont_example: Empty dashboard with no guidance on first login

description: Modals must close via X button Escape key and backdrop click
do_example: Modal has X button closes on Escape keypress and closes on overlay click
dont_example: Modal only closes via a small X button in the corner

description: When modal is open focus must be trapped inside the modal
do_example: Tab cycles through modal elements only and returns focus on close
dont_example: Tab key moves focus to elements behind the modal overlay

description: Destructive actions like delete need a confirmation dialog with clear language
do_example: Dialog: Delete project? This cannot be undone. [Cancel] [Delete]
dont_example: Single click on Delete immediately removes item with no confirmation

description: Tables must remain usable on mobile via horizontal scroll or card transformation
do_example: Table scrolls horizontally in a container on mobile with fixed first column
dont_example: Table breaks layout on mobile with columns overlapping

description: Sortable table columns need visual affordance showing sort direction
do_example: Column header with arrow icon showing current sort direction on click
dont_example: Sortable columns with no visual indication they are sortable

description: Table rows should have hover state and clear selection indicator if selectable
do_example: Rows highlight on hover with checkbox selection and blue selected state
dont_example: Plain table with no hover states and no visible selection

description: Pages should have one primary CTA with secondary and ghost button variants
do_example: Primary filled button for main action with outline button for secondary
dont_example: Three identical-looking primary buttons competing for attention

description: Buttons should show loading state and prevent double submission on click
do_example: Button shows spinner and disables during form submission
dont_example: Button remains clickable during submission causing duplicate requests

description: Buttons with icons should have consistent gap and alignment
do_example: flex items-center gap-2 with icon and text vertically centered
dont_example: Icon and text misaligned with inconsistent spacing

description: Show result count and highlight matched terms in search results
do_example: Showing 23 results for 'dashboard' with matched term highlighted
dont_example: Search returns results with no count or highlight

description: When search returns no results suggest alternatives or corrections
do_example: No results for 'dashbord'. Did you mean 'dashboard'? or try browsing categories
dont_example: Empty results page with only: No results found

description: Show current page total pages and allow direct page navigation
do_example: Page 3 of 12 with numbered page buttons and prev/next arrows
dont_example: Only Next button with no indication of total pages or current position

description: Infinite scroll must preserve scroll position on back navigation
do_example: Returning to list page restores previous scroll position and loaded items
dont_example: Going back to list reloads from the top losing user position

description: Infinite scroll needs a clear end-of-content indicator
do_example: Footer appears with: You've reached the end with load count
dont_example: Content just stops loading with no indication the list is complete
